d:
Mohammad Sharif was sentenced to death for his alleged role in the 2007 Rampur CRPF camp attack. After spending nearly 18 years in prison, the Allahabad High Court acquitted him of terrorism, murder and conspiracy charges, citing serious flaws in the investigation. He was released in November 2025. Nearly a year later, he was shot dead by two unidentified bike-borne assailants. Who killed him, and why? Is there any connection to the 2007 attack?
